id.description: Unique identifier for the logical object that instance of this type represents.

name.description: The name of the component. Optional field for informational purposes only.

dataSpec.description:
The data settings for this component.

@uiSdlDesignerCustomRenderer(rendererType='')

disableDataRequestOnFirstRender.description: Disable if you want to avoid sending any and all requests for this component on first render.

triggersRegistered.description: Whether the effect triggers and epics have been registered

wrapWithMetadataId.description: Whether to wrap the component with a div which has a class name of its metdata id. Useful for targeting with css.

baseModel.description:
The {@link ReliabilityMlModel} that is being cloned.

**NOTE**: This field is prepopulated by {@link CloningModelPrepopulateStateEpic}.

asset.description:
The {@link ReliabilityAsset} related to the model being cloned.

**NOTE**: This field is prepopulated by {@link CloningModelPrepopulateStateEpic}.

usingSensorAssociation.description:
Indicates whether the subject is a CV asset.

**NOTE**: This field is prepopulated by {@link CloningModelPrepopulateStateEpic}.

excludedSensors.description:
The current excluded {@link Sensor}s, that are not selected for the model to be cloned.

**NOTE**: This field is prepopulated by {@link CloningModelPrepopulateStateEpic}.

selectedSensors.description:
The current selected {@link Sensor}s, that are selected for the model to be cloned.

**NOTE**: This field is prepopulated by {@link CloningModelPrepopulateStateEpic}.

sensorsPlotted.description:
The list of {@link Sensor}s ids that are currently plotted on the 'Reliability.SensorPreviewChart'.
Indicates which sensors' data is currently plotted so that both
'Reliability.CloningModelSensorSelectionExcludedSensorsGrid' and the
'Reliability.CloningModelSensorSelectionSelectedSensorsGrid', can be updated accordingly.

hyperparameterData.description:
Original hyperparameter data retrieved from the base {@link ReliabilityMlModel}.

**NOTE**: This field is prepopulated by {@link CloningModelPrepopulateStateEpic}.

template.description:
The {@link ModelTemplate} used to clone the base {@link ReliabilityMlModel}.

**NOTE**: This field is prepopulated by {@link CloningModelPrepopulateStateEpic}.

dataPreparationUiSettings.description:
The {@link ReliabilityDataPreparationUiSettings} used for data preparation. Includes
fields like: trainingDatasetTimeRanges and validateDatasetTimeRanges.

**NOTE**: This field is prepopulated by {@link CloningModelPrepopulateStateEpic}.

datasetPreparationRun.description:
The {@link ReliabilityMlDatasetPreparationRun} used to create the base model's dataset.
Includes fields like: start, end and interval.

**NOTE**: This field is prepopulated by {@link CloningModelPrepopulateStateEpic}.

newModelName.description: The name of the new model to be created.

redirectTo.description: Stores where the user should be redirected to if they hit "exit anyway" in the exit modal

cvExclusionsFormFieldValues.description:
Stores the initial form field values of `Reliability.CloningModelExclusionsCVForm`.

**NOTE**: This field is prepopulated by {@link CloningModelPrepopulateStateEpic}.
**NOTE**: Not all fields from {@link BulkSensorAssociationUiDefaultableFields} are used.

selectedTemplate.description:
The currently selected template in `Reliability.CloningModelTemplatesGrid`.
It is updated through {@link CloningModelSelectModelTemplateEpic}

title: Application state for the model cloning workflow.
name: CloningModelApplicationState
